name: Enchanté "Hommage à mon Papa" Blue Lobster Bisque & Black Truffle Sea Scallops
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Enchanté by Chef Arnaud Lallement (Passion & Collection Menus)
whyItWorks: Chef Lallement's signature tribute to his father: butter-poached blue lobster in strained velvety bisque and seared sea scallops with Coteaux Champenois reduction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request your tasting courses prepared without citrus reduction (Chef Lallement's brigade customizes every course for dietary restrictions) and pair with a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Request zero lemon acidity when seated
